verdict.line: You lose if Jayce pokes you down in Cannon Stance before you ever reach melee range; you win every extended trade once you close the gap and your Grit shield is up.

brief.thesis: Jayce has no answer for sustained melee contact — his only escape is the short Thundering Blow knockback (Hammer E, 240 range) — so the entire lane is about whether he can keep you at Shock Blast range (Cannon Q, 600 range) or whether you force him into Hammer Stance brawling where Pit Grit's missing-health regen and Haymaker's stored shield take over.

theirWindow.what: He's threatening Shock Blast (16-8s cooldown, 600 range) and an Acceleration Gate for extra speed and missile range. Stay behind minions and don't approach without Q (Knuckle Down) active, since its move speed bonus only triggers while you're walking toward him.

yourWindow.when: Once you've closed to melee range
yourWindow.what: Jayce in Hammer Stance has no ranged tool besides Thundering Blow's single knockback. Pop W (Haymaker) for its stored Grit shield plus true-damage center hit, chain Q's bonus-damage attacks, and trust Pit Grit's missing-health regen to outlast him in the extended trade.

start.why: Picked in 67.5% of games at 54% win rate — the passive block and regen directly answer Jayce's auto-attack poke while you wait out his cooldowns to engage.

boots.why: 72.9% pick rate at 54.8% win rate — flattens the damage from his basic attacks and from Hyper Charge's attack-speed burst in Cannon Stance.

core.why: Gives you the burst of movement speed and on-hit damage to actually close the gap on a kiting ranged laner — the backbone of the highest win-rate path (64.3% over 235 games).
Stacking armor shred rewards repeated auto-attacks during the extended melee trades you're forcing.
Adds health and damage amplification, feeding Pit Grit's missing-health regen for longer fights.

situational.when: if you need burst mitigation to survive his Thundering Blow / Shock Blast combo during an all-in
if the game goes long and you need raw hp to out-sustain his poke
if you're struggling to physically catch him before he resets range

runes.keystoneWhy: Ramping adaptive force and the healing conversion at full stacks is built for exactly the kind of extended melee trade you're trying to force on Jayce.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 70% of games at 55.1% win rate — once Show Stopper lands at level 6, Ignite converts the all-in into a kill since Jayce has no hard disengage.

playing.title: Hold minions before level 6
playing.detail: Use the wave to block Shock Blast's line and his autos; don't walk up without Q's move-speed bonus already ticking from approaching him.

playing.title: Wait for Grit to fill
playing.detail: Haymaker's shield comes from stored damage taken — don't cast it early just to clear a wave. Its cooldown (18 down to 12s) means every cast needs to count.

playing.title: Angle Facebreaker off a minion
playing.detail: In a pure 1v1, Facebreaker only slows since Jayce is on one side of you. Pull him against a minion or wave to get enemies on opposite sides and convert it into the stun.

playing.title: Save Show Stopper for overextensions
playing.detail: R's cooldown (120s down to 80s at rank 3) is long, so only spend it when he's pushed past the safety of minions — he can't escape it with anything but a lucky Thundering Blow knockback.

playing.title: Respect Cannon Stance, ignore Hammer Stance
playing.detail: Check his stance before committing: Cannon Stance means Shock Blast and Acceleration Gate are live; Hammer Stance means he has nothing ranged and you should be walking at him.

playing.title: Trade off your passive regen
playing.detail: Pit Grit heals harder the lower your health drops — don't panic and disengage a close fight, since his lack of sustain means the extended trade usually swings back your way.

playing.title: Flex Teleport if behind
playing.detail: Flash+Teleport is run in 13.2% of games — a reasonable swap if Doran's Shield sustain runs out and you need to reset rather than force all-ins you can't win yet.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above come from measured Sett vs Jayce games on the current patch; the trade-timing and mechanical reasoning are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Jayce punish you during early game by keeping your distance. Be careful of his (Q)-(E) pokes while using your lane sustain to fight him whenever your skills come off cooldown.
